description: Land Acquisition - Thalakiriyagama, Galewela D/S Division, Matale District
reasoning: This gazette notice is a land acquisition notice published under Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically deals with the state's intention to acquire multiple land parcels and servitudes for the Kurunegala-Habarana Railway Project. The content provides detailed descriptions of the lands to be acquired, including lot numbers, land names, types, claimants, and extents. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it concerns land acquisition for public purposes.
